title: End-to-End Neural Shrinkage of Indefinite Pairwise Correlation Matrices for Small-Cap-Inclusive Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2608.30446v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small-cap-inclusive equity universes contain recently listed and intermittently traded securities, so enforcing a common look-back discards a substantial fraction of the available information. Pairwise-complete estimation preserves the longest overlap for each asset pair, but the resulting correlation matrix can be indefinite because its entries are computed on different samples. This prevents direct use in Markowitz optimization and falls outside the assumptions of standard random-matrix shrinkage. We adapt a rotation-invariant neural covariance estimator to this setting. The model computes mask-aware marginal moments and a pairwise correlation matrix proxy, processes its signed spectrum, and uses a bidirectional gated recurrent unit conditioned on factor-aligned effective sample lengths derived from the overlap matrix and eigenvector loadings. translated_title: 面向含小盘股投资组合的不定成对相关矩阵的端到端神经收缩方法
translated_abstract: 包含小盘股的股票池中存在近期上市和间歇性交易的证券，因此强制要求统一的回溯期会丢弃大量可用信息。成对完整估计方法保留了每对资产之间最长的重叠期，但由于其元素是在不同的样本上计算的，所得的相关矩阵可能是不定的（非正定）。这使得该矩阵无法直接用于马科维茨优化，也超出了标准随机矩阵收缩方法的假设范围。我们将一种旋转不变的神经协方差估计器适配到该场景。该模型计算感知掩码的边际矩和成对相关矩阵代理，处理其带符号谱，并使用一个双向门控循环单元（GRU），其条件输入为从重叠矩阵和特征向量载荷推导出的、与因子对齐的有效样本长度。该方法将所有特征值（包括负特征值）映射到正的逆谱上。（原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种端到端神经收缩方法，将因小盘股数据重叠不一致而产生的不定成对相关矩阵转化为可用于马科维茨投资组合优化的正定矩阵。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end neural shrinkage method that transforms indefinite pairwise correlation matrices—caused by inconsistent data overlaps in small-cap-inclusive universes—into positive definite matrices suitable for Markowitz portfolio optimization.
